description: Seed problems for matched generation: each has a strong (reference) spec and a trusted reference implementation. Used as phi_strong for check_e and as the differential-testing oracle.

problems.problem_nl: Return the maximum of two integers.
problems.signature: method Max(a: int, b: int) returns (r: int)
problems.reference_impl: if a >= b { r := a; } else { r := b; }

problems.problem_nl: Return a sequence whose length is exactly twice that of s.
Return the first element of s.
